releases.body:
First public release of **opencode-0-injection**.

OpenCode server plugin that prepends a priority-zero operational prompt before the agent prompt via the `experimental.chat.system.transform` hook.

Final system prompt order:
\`\`\`
0-injection-prompt -> agent prompt -> environment -> instruction
\`\`\`

## Features
- Priority-zero prompt injection with marker-wrapped, idempotent transform (no duplicate accumulation on retries)
- Configurable prompt file via the \`file\` option (default \`0-injection-prompt.md\`)
- mtime-cached prompt reader; zero runtime dependencies (ESM, Node builtins only)
- Smoke test verifying ordering and idempotency (\`npm test\`)

## Install
Reference by npm package or local path in \`opencode.json\`:
\`\`\`json
{ "plugin": [ ["opencode-0-injection", { "file": "0-injection-prompt.md" }] ] }
\`\`\`

## Docs
README available in 22 languages (see language selector at the top of README.md).
